title: Bright Yellow Anywhere
style: warm folk-pop, subtle dub-techno underbed, 96 BPM, female lead vocal, soft brushes, walking bass, light vibraphone, gentle and bright, cross-genre
lyrics:
[Intro - vibraphone twinkle, soft brushes, walking bass enters]
(spoken, warm, female)
bright yellow on the kitchen line.
bright yellow on the dispatcher's screen.
same colour means the same thing -
go.

[Verse 1 - female, warm, half-sung]
bright yellow on the kitchen line means soft hands
bright yellow on the dispatcher's screen means stand by
bright yellow on the morning bus means the day's beginning
bright yellow on the safety vest means see me, see me, see me
all the same colour
all the same word
all the same nervous-system signal
all the same - i am here, i am ready, i am heard

[Pre-Chorus - vibraphone rises, walking bass walks]
yellow is the colour of attention
yellow is the colour of being seen
wherever yellow lives, somebody's saying
don't pass me by - i am in the scene

[Chorus - full warm folk-pop swell, dub-techno sub very quiet underneath]
bright yellow anywhere
bright yellow anywhere
on the court, on the screen, on the road, on the chair
bright yellow anywhere
means we're awake, means we're aware
means somebody chose to be here
bright yellow anywhere
means somebody cares

[Verse 2 - female, slightly fuller]
the coach in the bright yellow shirt sees the new player
the operator in the bright yellow chair sees the new call
the kid in the bright yellow raincoat sees the puddles
and jumps anyway - jumps anyway, through them all
yellow is the colour of arriving
yellow is the colour of go
yellow is the colour of the ball that everybody chases
because everybody knows

[Bridge - brushes drop out, vibraphone alone, spoken]
the kitchen line and the dispatcher's screen are not different rooms.
they are both rooms where somebody chose to stay attentive.
both rooms where somebody said i'll be here when it matters.
the colour is just the badge.
the staying is the work.

[Final Chorus - biggest, full band returns, sub a touch louder]
bright yellow anywhere
bright yellow anywhere
on the court, on the screen, on the road, on the chair
bright yellow anywhere
means we're awake, means we're aware
means somebody chose to be here
bright yellow anywhere
means somebody cares
bright yellow anywhere
means somebody cares

[Outro - vibraphone fades, walking bass walks out, spoken]
bright yellow on the kitchen line.
bright yellow on the dispatcher's screen.
same colour.
same word.
go.
